author.name: Horace Chan
author.headline: Expert in applying AI in verification

text:
Is it just me, I found the M365 Copilot meeting summary is totally human unreadable. I think M$FT is cheap, it uses a dumb LLM to generate the default summary.

I have to ask Copilot to re-summarize the meeting again, stress that only tell me what is the important and cut all the BS.

comments.text: Copilot is so horrible that I don't use it for anything.
